name: InputStoryContentPhoto
description: Describes a photo to post as a story.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the content, must be _photo_

fields.name: photo
fields.description: The photo to post as a story. The photo must be of the size 1080x1920 and must not exceed 10 MB. The photo can't be reused and can only be uploaded as a new file, so you can pass “attach://<file\_attach\_name>” if the photo was uploaded using multipart/form-data under <file\_attach\_name>. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)
